title: The Enemy from Within: A Study of Political Delegitimization Discourse in Israeli Political Speech
reasoning: The paper uses LLMs as tools to identify and classify political delegitimization discourse in Hebrew political speech. While the coding scheme includes categories like 'common good' and 'incivility,' the research is a computational social science study focused on tracking political rhetoric trends and benchmarking detection performance, rather than evaluating the religious, moral, or ethical reasoning or values of the LLMs themselves.
